description: This PHP source file defines the Register class within the Opencart e-commerce platform, responsible for handling registration email notifications and alerts. It includes methods for sending registration confirmation and alert emails, loading necessary models and language files, and constructing email content.

classes.name: Register
classes.description: Controller class for handling registration email notifications and alerts within the Opencart platform.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Handles the process of sending a registration email to the new customer, including loading language, customer group info, and creating a task for email delivery.

methods.name: alert
methods.description: Sends alert notifications to admin and additional emails when a new customer registers, including customer details and customer group info.
